parse.title: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
====Karambwan-poisoned spear====
{{Checklist|*Buy a [[raw karambwan]] off the [[Grand Exchange]]
*Cook it on any cooking utility to get a [[poison karambwan]]
*Grind the poison karambwan with a [[pestle and mortar]]
*Use the [[karambwan paste]] on your spear}}
